question: What dates does Alibaba's FY2026 cover, and why must it not be interpreted as the calendar year ending 31 December 2026?
reference_answer: Alibaba FY2026 covers 1 April 2025 through 31 March 2026; it is Alibaba's fiscal year, not calendar year 2026.
raw_model_answer: Alibaba Group (09988) has a 31 March fiscal year-end. Its FY2026 therefore covers 1 April 2025 through 31 March 2026, as confirmed by the “FISCAL YEAR 2026 ANNUAL REPORT” published on HKEXnews on 18 June 2026. It must not be read as the calendar year ending 31 December 2026: the “FY2026” label refers to the fiscal year ended 31 March 2026, not to calendar year 2026.
